findings.title: [P2] Fix the source checkout path relative to the controller
findings.body: At the supplied repository location, `P.parents[2]` already resolves to `.../efficiency-20261015/finish-20261017`. Appending `finish-20261017/ci-green/repo` therefore duplicates the `finish-20261017` directory. The first `git ls-tree` call will fail because its working directory does not identify the intended source checkout, preventing all seven checks. Resolve the checkout as `P.parents[2]/'ci-green/repo'` for this layout, or accept an explicit source-checkout path.

overall_explanation: The controller resolves the source checkout incorrectly in the supplied directory layout, blocking the bounded inspection. Review was based on the complete supplied controller and generator; local shell inspection was unavailable because the sandbox failed to initialize. No project code was executed or files modified.
